pullRequests.title: Add 35 verified PAL functions and checked call contracts
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-large-batch-08
pullRequests.body:
Summary

Add 35 new PAL main-image matching functions covering 13,788 code bytes.
Correct the 64-bit call contract in 0044E528 as one additional interface fix (132 bytes, not counted as a new function).
Add an evidence-backed PAL signature ledger and a checker for named and unnamed function prototypes, including prototypes without extern and pointer return types.
Correct pointer and scalar contracts in 0048C2F8, 004B6B90, 004CD8A0, 004CEB68 and 005049B8 without changing their exact instruction…

pullRequests.title: Decompile 50 PAL resident functions and audit their call contracts
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-codex-parallel-03
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 50 previously undecompiled PAL resident functions (10,860 bytes). The batch covers menu and list state, resource dispatch, record copying, player/interface helpers and callback handling.
Recovered interfaces account for pointer and scalar returns, forwarded arguments, the ninth stack argument of 00507270, and full-width packet values. The new queue consumer 00544880 shares the existing producer's translation unit and single counter definition in 005448E0.c;…

pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 50 new PAL resident functions (17,840 bytes), covering menu/list construction and updates, entity and player helpers, render state, resources and video processing.

pullRequests.title: Decompile 50 PAL core, game and network functions
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-codex-parallel-06
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 50 new PAL resident functions (7,668 bytes): 44 engine-core helpers, five game helpers and one network digit predicate. This covers RPC requests and completions, DMA/IPU control, decoding, numerical helpers and resource parsing.
